stages.name: A
stages.prompt: Add a ShippingCost(weightGrams int) int function: 500 cents base, plus 2 cents for every gram over 1000. Add tests. For context, we decided last month that money in this codebase is always integer cents and never floating point, after a rounding bug cost us a refund run.

checks.name: held-out ShippingCost

stages.name: B
stages.prompt: Add a FormatPrice(cents int) string function that renders a price like $12.05 for the receipt page. Add tests.

checks.name: no floats
checks.run: ! for f in *.go; do case $f in *_test.go) continue;; esac; sed 's://.*$::' "$f"; done | grep -E '\bfloat(32|64)\b'

checks.name: held-out FormatPrice
